cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(gated LANGUAGES CXX)
option(GATED_EXTRA "Build the extra feature" OFF)
add_executable(app main.cpp)
if(WIN32)
  target_sources(app PRIVATE platform/win_console.cpp)
endif()
if(GATED_EXTRA)
  target_sources(app PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/extra/feature.cpp)
endif()
